title: Kimi K2.7 Code is generally available in GitHub Copilot
summary: GitHub announced that Kimi K2.7, a large language model from Chinese AI company Moonshot AI (月之暗面), is now generally available as a model option in GitHub Copilot, giving developers access to Kimi's code generation and assistance capabilities within the Copilot ecosystem.
problem_solved: Provides developers using GitHub Copilot with an additional AI model choice beyond the default model for code completion and assistance tasks.
why_valuable: Expands model options for developers, potentially offering better performance for certain coding tasks or preferences, especially for users familiar with Kimi's capabilities.
